name: Stepped shaft
description: Coaxial stepped shaft from cylinders: fuse shoulders, optional fillet, export one solid.

steps.goal: Create the largest diameter cylinder as the primary envelope.
steps.exit_criteria: At least one body exists representing the shaft envelope.

steps.goal: Add shoulders with cylinders, fuse coaxially, cut/bore ends if needed, fillet.
steps.exit_criteria: Stepped solid fused; ready to export.

steps.goal: Optionally insert key/retaining features from catalog.
steps.exit_criteria: Standards inserted or step skipped when toggle is off.
